name: Masaki Tomoyuki
source:
Masaki is an unemployed man whose life takes a dramatic turn. His story begins in Inokashira Park, where a failed suicide attempt leads him to cross paths with [url=/c4079]Tokisaka Yukari[/url], who finds and rescues him. 

Following his recovery in the hospital, he joins the Tokisaka Detective Agency as a temporary assistant. This opportunity arises partly because of his inability to fully use his left hand, a consequence of his suicide attempt. Furthermore, he feels a sense of obligation towards [url=/c4078]Tokisaka[/url], who not only saved his life but also gave him a blood transfusion.

Despite his grumblings about the demanding nature of the work, Masaki continues to assist [url=/c4078]Reiji[/url]. Lacking other pursuits in life and driven by his passive disposition, he sees this role as a path to follow for now. Masaki is known for his mature personality, which, depending on the situation, can be both an asset and a hindrance. He tends to maintain a distance from others, creating a barrier that defines his interactions and relationships.

”...It looks like I’ve escaped death once again.”

[Edited from [url=http://www.mangagamer.com/detail.php?goods_type=1&product_code=139]MangaGamer[/url]]

[spoiler]Showing no disturbance at the death of a close acquaintance, Ayato was noted for his diminished emotions and was prompted to resume visits to the psychiatrist he had previously seen.

Currently, he is aiding in the search for a childhood friend who has turned into a criminal and disappeared. [/spoiler]
